evidence_policy.n_a_policy: N/A cannot pass. A criterion not exercised by the main Arm C build must cite its named isolated acceptance receipt.
evidence_policy.no_all_eight_rule: Acceptance cases execute independently with one selected route each. They must never be concatenated into an all-eight treatment run.

criteria.name: context before copy
criteria.visible_evidence: The method receipt grounds the draft in the Product Truth Packet, audience, action, and swipe set before writing.

criteria.name: 5-3-1 swipe discipline
criteria.visible_evidence: All five controls are read, S2/S1/S3 are broken down, and S2 remains primary for relevance.

criteria.name: promise hierarchy
criteria.visible_evidence: One evidence-derived promise governs beats, sentences, and emotional language.

criteria.name: evidence-derived mechanism
criteria.visible_evidence: No causal explanation is invented backward from a desired headline.

criteria.name: four-beat opening progression
criteria.visible_evidence: Interrupt, consequential claim, credibility, and demonstrated result remain distinct and ordered.

criteria.name: first-four continuation test
criteria.visible_evidence: The first lines make the reader want the next line without stacking compensating questions.

criteria.name: thumbtack continuity
criteria.visible_evidence: One named concept carries across adjacent sentences.

criteria.name: proof texture
criteria.visible_evidence: Naked adjectives are replaced with relevant, fixture-grounded comparative detail.

criteria.name: mumbo-jumbo control
criteria.visible_evidence: Undefined abstractions are removed or reduced to one supported idea.

criteria.name: negative-space diagnosis
criteria.visible_evidence: The system identifies the missing structural element before line editing.

criteria.name: Four Punches distinction and bounded use
criteria.visible_evidence: Four Punches is treated as a move language, never mislabeled as the separate four-beat opening.

criteria.name: truth and attribution discipline
criteria.visible_evidence: Synthetic facts stay qualified, self-reported credentials do not transfer, Matthew-owned material remains attributed, and feedback is non-shaming.

pass_rule: All twelve criteria score at least 7 from declared main-arm or named acceptance-case evidence, KF-12 scores exactly 10, all eighteen isolated acceptance cases pass, and at least three named Kyle mechanics create inspectable main-arm output deltas.
proof_boundary: A pass is source-fidelity evidence on one synthetic fixture, not A-tier embodiment proof.
